sign_off.notes: Tested: medicine editor category pickers (all 5 categories look right), medicine creation (custom and estradiol), group creation, group history generation with a past start date (completed doses show on Plan, History and Home, and the estimate updates), and Calibration (add/edit results, unit switching, target conversion). One open issue: on the Calibration list, a result card shows only the first test, plus Testosterone if present. It omits Prolactin and Progesterone, although the "+1 record" chip counts them and the editor shows them as saved. I reported this three times and each time the developer replied "could not reproduce", so it stays unconfirmed. I did not try other groups or other history-generation options (missed, hide), weekly schedules, or rotation.
